entry_points.text: Early 32 bit code reserves top space by rounding down to a middle boundary and lowering the fixed ceiling before any fixed map; two boot options size the allocator reserve with a guard hole or reserve top then reinitialize mappings, rejecting missing arguments.

Emergency handling needs interrupts disabled and invokes technology specific disable with reboot flag and guest callback; boot probes both technologies installing the single success and warning if both succeed.

exports.text: Top creation allocates the top, preallocates kernel and user lowers, stores it in the address space and fails null; release tears down preallocated tables, runs hooks and frees the top.
Per level access helpers report whether the proposal differs and store only when dirty is indicated; youth helpers report prior youth and clear accessed atomically only when previously young.
64 bit translation splits image aliases above the base from direct map below with error checks; 32 bit uses direct offset excluding vmalloc and fixed map, gating validity on frames.
Isolation exposes early setup that shares platform areas and normalizes globals, and late completion that reshares split entry code, shares eligible image parts and validates user mappings.
Context operations leave, switch, borrow and restore temporary contexts with interrupt guards; flush operations cover single user address, global, local processor and batched unmap paths.
Acquisition validates dispatch and feature then enables hardware on the zero to one transition with rollback on failure; release disables on the last put and treats failure as fatal unless rebooting.

hazards.text: Large paths enforce huge alignment and warn on invalidating non present entries; zapped checks warn on shadow stack encodings outside shadow areas; the user walk tolerates a large middle mapping only during a late text phase.

Single entry invalidation with a nonzero identifier faults when PCID handling is off so state must be checked first; unassisted global rewrite races preemption and interrupts; local reload needs preemption disabled.

Entry faults report the feature control register and clear extensions; concurrent emergency faults are tolerated once rebooting; clearing reverse map state while secure paging is active faults; preparation fails on bad reservations, coverage gaps or offline processors.
Flush, virt and table setup rely on opaque helpers for page address lookup, CPU iteration, page release, frame derivation and RCU publish, treated as external in this pass.

invariants.text: Teardown clears nonzero slots before freeing lowers with counter updates, adding user shadows when enabled; prepopulation installs one table per slot from zero, seeding kernel slots from the global table.

Kernel flush prepares page granularity with invalid generation, full when normalized end indicates everything; it prefers broadcast instructions else a broadcast routine, chunking hardware ranges with a barrier.

Cloning skips empty uppers by rounding forward, shares present sources as tables or entries with global marking, aborting on missing tops or bad granularity; user walks allocate zeroed levels for kernel addresses only; image sharing needs four negatives; vsyscall clones a small populated entry.

Init validates loaded tables, disabled tagging and identifier enable, forces untagged base with flush and resets slots; remote need is false for lazy and true for kernel only, switching or matching context; local helpers count receipts and rebuild the expected base.

Each processor keeps root control pages stamped with the hardware revision; enable rejects already active extensions with tracing for one technology, disable clears state even on fault; callback registration ignores duplicates and unregistration waits for readers.

Table setup validates a contiguous reservation with bookkeeping and self coverage or walks firmware segments requiring full RAM coverage, mapping bookkeeping last with full unwind on failure; clearing zeroes state unless active; preparation enables fixup and secure paging per processor; cmdline handles debug and nosnp tokens.

locks.text: Fresh table population holds the global table guard; kernel flush setup holds a preemption guard; temporary borrow and release need preemption off with interrupt guards; holder updates run preemption guarded; emergency requires interrupts disabled.

state_machines.text: Isolation mode rests in automatic, forced off or forced on, selected by a boot string with a separate option forcing off; early setup shares writable entry code and late completion moves to split entries with partial image sharing.

Holder count stays disabled at zero, enables on first acquisition, stays enabled while nested, and disables on the last release; secure paging preparation returns if active else clears state, requires all processors online, flushes caches and enables bits per processor.

structs.text: Context packs a sixteen bit identifier with a flush bit starting the counter at one; speculation uses one for branch barrier and two for cache flush; usable identifiers derive from hardware width minus isolation consumption minus two.

Dispatch holds a feature tag with enable, disable and emergency callbacks plus a rebooting flag; firmware reverse map entries pack guest address, status flags and identifier without padding; range descriptors hold array pointer, bound and size with fixed bookkeeping, shift and mask values.

The 32 bit allocator reserve and fixed map ceiling set boot time bounds; key disable shifts by index times bits per key with an initial value denying keys one to fifteen; isolation allocation never tracks and image cloning uses middle granularity.
